items.definition:
relating to the sun
Many homes now use solar panels to generate electricity.

final; fundamental; best or most extreme
Our ultimate goal is to achieve peace.

relating to the outside of something
The building has an external staircase.

relating to a president or presidency
The presidential election will be held next year.

main; most important
The principal reason for his success was hard work.

equal in value, amount, function, meaning, etc.
One dollar is equivalent to 100 cents.

exceptionally good; not yet paid, resolved, or dealt with
Her performance was truly outstanding.

modern, current
She is a leading figure in contemporary art.

covering a large area or range
The company has extensive experience in this field.

relating to everyone or everything
Love is a universal emotion.

very great in extent or quantity
The desert stretched out before them, vast and empty.

acting or done in the same way over time
Her performance has been consistent all season.

considered in relation or in proportion to something else
The cost is relative to the quality.

not likely to change or fail
The economy is finally stable.

concerned with the principles of right and wrong behavior
It's important to make moral choices.

causing someone to feel upset, angry, or insulted
His comments were highly offensive to many people.

deserving or inviting derision or mockery; absurd
That's a ridiculous idea; it will never work.

higher in rank, status, or quality
This new model is superior to the old one in every way.

relating to the running of a business, organization, etc.
He works in the administrative department.

total, without deductions; or, very unpleasant
His gross income is higher than his net income.

ideal
This is the ideal place for a picnic.

relating to Islam
We visited an Islamic art museum.

without clothes
The baby was naked after its bath.

relating to strategy; important for a plan
This was a strategic move to gain market share.

achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense
The new system is much more efficient.

prejudiced against a race
His comments were widely condemned as racist.

sudden and striking; relating to drama
There was a dramatic change in the weather.

mad; crazy
The idea sounds completely insane.

produced without artificial chemicals
She prefers to buy organic vegetables.

relating to the spirit or soul
She is on a spiritual journey.

of extreme force, degree, or strength
The heat was intense during the summer.

coming after something in time; following
The subsequent events were even more surprising.

protective, guarding
He became defensive when questioned about his actions.

legitimate, acceptable
Your passport is valid for another six months.

essential, crucial
It is vital to stay hydrated.

real; authentic
This is a genuine leather bag.

including all or nearly all elements or aspects of something
The report provides a comprehensive overview.

very unusual or remarkable
She has an extraordinary talent for music.

heroic or grand in scale or character
That was an epic movie.

related to farming
The region is known for its agricultural products.

relating to genes
They are studying genetic diseases.

favoring social reform or new ideas
The company has a progressive approach to employee benefits.

relating to a population subgroup with a common cultural tradition
The city is known for its diverse ethnic groups.

forming a necessary base or core
Understanding the fundamental principles is crucial.

relating to machines or machinery
The car had a mechanical problem.

of superior quality or value
They offer premium services to their clients.

important or famous
He is a prominent figure in the community.

relating to an area where people live
This is a quiet residential area.

remaining the same in all cases and at all times; unchanging in form or character
The quality of the products is uniform.

clearly visible or understood; obvious
It was apparent that he was tired.

feeling or showing a hopeless sense that a situation is so bad as to be impossible to deal with
He made a desperate attempt to save his drowning friend.

continuing; still in progress
The negotiations are still ongoing.

enough; adequate
We have sufficient food for everyone.

almost or nearly as described, but not completely or according to strict definition
We attended a virtual meeting online.

relating to biology or living organisms
She is studying biological sciences at university.

characterized by constant change, activity, or progress
The city has a dynamic and growing economy.

relating to literature
She has a strong interest in literary criticism.

unlikely
It's unlikely that he will come now.

collective
This was a collective effort from the whole team.

intellectual
She is a highly intellectual person.

relating to race
The company is committed to promoting racial equality.

unfamiliar or foreign
The customs of the new country felt alien to him.

clearly separate and different
The two cultures have distinct traditions.

having the right to do or obtain something
Only citizens are eligible to vote.
